coordinate_semantics.xy_position: MuMu 4353 current-view unit coordinates are calibrated into the JCC 4x7 board grid by tools/jcc-mumu-board-grid.mjs.
coordinate_semantics.chess_position_api: Likely wraps logical chess position and XYPosition. Field names remain obfuscated in retained DEX evidence.
coordinate_semantics.bench_axis: Do not infer left-to-right bench slot from raw x alone without visual calibration; previous y=-1/x=4 samples are action-log coordinates, not proven UI slot numbers.
coordinate_semantics.board_axis: Board grid is emitted only for units whose MuMu XY falls inside the calibrated board band and only promoted to own board after shop self-view anchoring.

bench_exclusion_evidence.policy: Bench-band units must not snap to board row 4 even when 4352 bench evidence is absent.

expected_runtime_adapter_shape.board_units: array of {unit_id, name?, star?, items?, position:{source:'visual_roi'|'mumu_candidate', row?, col?, x?, y?, confidence}}
expected_runtime_adapter_shape.bench_units: array of {unit_id, name?, slot?, position:{source:'visual_roi'|'mumu_candidate', x?, y?, confidence}}
expected_runtime_adapter_shape.candidate_actions: array of {kind:'buy'|'sell'|'move', from?, to?, observed_at, evidence_source}

promotion_guard: MuMu position candidates can seed ROI and parser names, but final board_units/bench_units require current-frame visual evidence or a verified action reducer scoped to the current match.
